# Raydrim

> Raydrim is a bespoke digital engineering studio and product development agency founded by Muhammad Taki Ahmed in Dhaka, Bangladesh. We build high-performance Next.js web applications, Shopify e-commerce platforms, cross-platform mobile apps, and custom software systems with guaranteed full source code ownership.

## Studio Overview
- Official Website: https://raydrim.com
- Founder & Principal Engineer: Muhammad Taki Ahmed
- Engineering Headquarters: Dhaka-1230, Bangladesh
- Direct Contact: contact@raydrim.com | +880 1873-691022
- Architecture: Next.js 16 App Router, TypeScript, React 19, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, AWS Amplify & CloudFront CDN edge delivery.

## Core Capabilities & Services
- [Web Application Development](https://raydrim.com/services): Bespoke web platforms built for speed, conversion, and global scale.
- [Shopify E-Commerce Stores](https://raydrim.com/pricing#shopify): Turnkey, high-converting luxury storefronts with seamless payment gateways.
- [Mobile App Development](https://raydrim.com/pricing#mobile): WebView wrappers and React Native cross-platform iOS & Android mobile applications.
- [Client Portfolio](https://raydrim.com/portfolio): Proven production case studies and client applications.
- [Engineering Vault](https://raydrim.com/vault): Reusable software modules, design components, and full-stack blueprints.
- [Pricing Plans](https://raydrim.com/pricing): Transparent, fixed-price contracts with clear delivery milestones.
- [Engineering Blog](https://raydrim.com/blog): In-depth technical articles on Next.js performance, e-commerce optimization, and full-stack software architecture.

## Brand Ecosystem & Ventures
- [Nyxeris](https://nyxeris.store): Flagship luxury workspace hardware, CNC wireless charging gear, and curated everyday carry.
- [CampusDude](https://campusdude.site): Distraction-free browser gaming platform, student study breaks, and cognitive focus ergonomics.
